turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a call at 4:40, so start with why my son found out about a zero on his phone, in the middle of a class, before anyone called me.
"Heard your points." That isn't an answer, Hale; who entered the zero, and why wasn't I called first?
With respect, this is exactly what lawyers do. Make noise until the facts go away.
"Make noise until the facts go away." I'm writing that down, Hale, and I'd be delighted to see facts, so put one on the table.
Your son cheated, and you're teaching him that Mom can make it disappear.

My son wrote that essay, and you've just called him a cheater to my face without showing me a single page. I'm writing that down too. When we're done here, I'm going straight to the principal's office.
